data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the router (20-3600s). Each enabled OID is an HTTPS request; keep ≥60s on small cellular CPEs.
data_description.consider_home: How long a device may be unseen before it is marked away.
data_description.track_all: When off, only clients already known to Home Assistant (or already tracked) get entities. When on, every LAN client the router reports is added.
data_description.poll_cellwan: Extra OID for cellular detail (IMEI, SIM, SCC/CA). Core signal/bands are already in status. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
data_description.poll_lan: Extra OID for DHCP/LAN IP settings. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
data_description.poll_traffic: Extra OID for per-interface traffic counters. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
data_description.poll_cardpage: Extra OID with dashboard/card-page fields. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
data_description.poll_wifi_mesh: Extra OID for EasyMesh settings. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
data_description.poll_one_connect: Extra OID for One Connect. Off by default. Disabling removes related sensors.
